summary: Mandates 33% reservation of seats for women in the Lok Sabha, the Legislative Assembly of the National Capital Territory of Delhi, and all State Legislative Assemblies for a 15-year period following the next census and subsequent delimitation.
statement_of_objects: To enhance democratic representation of women in national and state lawmaking bodies.
statement_of_objects_and_reasons: To enhance democratic representation of women in national and state lawmaking bodies.
text:
AMENDMENT ACT: Constitution (One Hundred and Sixth Amendment) Act, 2023 (Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam) (2023)
PROVISIONS AFFECTED: Article 239AA, Article 330A, Article 332A, Article 334A
SUMMARY: Mandates 33% reservation of seats for women in the Lok Sabha, the Legislative Assembly of the National Capital Territory of Delhi, and all State Legislative Assemblies for a 15-year period following the next census and subsequent delimitation.
STATEMENT OF OBJECTS AND REASONS: To enhance democratic representation of women in national and state lawmaking bodies.
